meta.name: hyperframes-audio
meta.description: Use when audio already placed in a HyperFrames composition needs to be mixed: fade-in/fade-out, crossfade, track gain or volume, volume automation, ducking, a music bed that fights a voiceover (voiceover carve), effects on a track (EQ, compressor, limiter, gate, saturation, delay, reverb, chorus, phaser, bitcrush), automation envelopes drawn on a track's volume or any effect parameter, or one submix bus carrying a chain, a fader and an automation clock for several tracks at once (`<hf-audio-group>`). Don't use for sourcing or generating audio — finding BGM, SFX, or making a voiceover is `/media-use`. Don't use for clip timing or track layout, which is `/hyperframes-core`.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让配音和背景音乐不再互相盖住,把音量、淡化与效果调到刚好。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果视频旁白总被背景音乐压住,或需要给多条音轨统一调音。
copy.tagline_en: Balance voiceover against music and shape fades, ducking and effects per track.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your voiceover keeps getting buried by the music and you need it fixed.

howto.what: 给已放进 HyperFrames 合成里的音频做混音:淡入淡出、交叉淡化、轨道增益与音量自动化、闪避/配音挖槽、效果链(EQ、压缩、混响等)、自动化包络,以及用 <hf-audio-group> 一条总线同时带多条轨道。它不负责找音源或生成音频。
howto.when: 当你要求对已放置在 HyperFrames 合成中的音频做混音处理(如淡入淡出、闪避等)时触发。找音源或生成音频用 /media-use,片段时序与轨道布局用 /hyperframes-core。

say.text: 给旁白底下的音乐床做闪避,让解说听得清
say.note: 在音乐床元素上写 data-fx-carve 并生成包络

say.text: 给音乐床加 2 秒淡入、3 秒淡出
say.note: 为已放置轨道生成淡化包络

say.text: 用 80Hz 高通去掉这段人声的低频隆隆声
say.note: 在 data-fx-chain 里加一个 highpass

howto.what_en: Claude mixes audio already placed in a HyperFrames composition: fade-in/out, crossfades, track gain, volume automation, ducking/voiceover carve, effect chains, envelopes, and a submix bus. It does not source or generate audio.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want audio already placed in a HyperFrames composition mixed, e.g. fades or ducking. Sourcing or generating audio is /media-use; clip timing and track layout are /hyperframes-core.

say_en.text: Duck the music bed under this voiceover so the narration stays clear
say_en.note: Writes data-fx-carve on the bed element

say_en.text: Add a 2-second fade-in and 3-second fade-out to the music bed
say_en.note: Fade envelopes on the placed track

say_en.text: Highpass this voice at 80 Hz to cut the rumble
